messages:
acme_integration: Hey — hitting 400 on /v1/rerank. Happens for some users. Here's curl we used:

acme_integration: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"queries":["best laptop"],"candidates":[{"id":"1","content":"Dell XPS 13"},{"id":"2","content":"MacBook Air"}],"top_k":1}'
```

acme_integration: Response: 400 Bad Request
acme_integration: {"error":"invalid_request","message":"candidate object missing required property 'text'"}

jamie_support: Thanks — can you paste the exact request body (no creds) and SDK version? Does this happen for every request?

acme_integration: Same payload as above, happens ~10% of the time. Using internal SDK v2.3.6 and sometimes our integration strips/renames keys.

noah_eng: I see a schema validation error in logs for your tenant: "ValidationError: Missing required property 'text' in candidates[1]". The rerank schema requires candidate.text (string).

noah_eng: Quick repro: server rejects when candidate lacks 'text' key even if 'content' exists.

jamie_support: Workaround for now — rename 'content' -> 'text' in payload. We can also add a transformation in your proxy.

acme_integration: Can the API accept 'content' as alias? Changing 3rd-party integration is slow.

noah_eng: Supportable change but needs product sign-off. For short term we'll add clearer error with candidate index so you can map failures; engineering will follow up with a patch proposal.

jamie_support: Logged internal ticket INF-1258 and a customer-facing runbook. I'll email the workaround and ETA.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-1258 and assigned to eng-noah.

acme_integration: Thanks — applying client patch and will monitor. Please keep us posted on alias support.

jamie_support: Will update this thread when we have PR. :thumbsup:
